descriptions.s19_grid_cell_ref4_800203a0: Appears to return the address of the second word of a 12-byte cell in a grid selected by index, using that grid's row stride.
descriptions.s19_grid_cell_ref8_800203cc: Appears to return the address of the third word of a 12-byte cell in a grid selected by index, using that grid's row stride.
descriptions.s19_bitgrid_set_8002c6dc: Appears to set one bit in a bit-word array addressed by two offsets and a row stride stored in the object.
descriptions.s19_bitgrid_clear_8002c70c: Appears to clear one bit in a bit-word array addressed by two offsets and a row stride stored in the object.
descriptions.s19_limit_forward_800356e0: Appears to forward a float to a helper when the first float argument is not below the float limit stored at +0x334.
descriptions.s19_slot_matches_global_80015400: Appears to compare a byte of an indexed record at +0xd5 with a small-data global and return whether they are equal.
